name: add/postgres-string-with-password
note: The string's password is stripped before it is stored; the fields are stored as typed.

name: add/password-not-saved
note: savePassword false: the TS deletes a db: entry that can't exist yet.

name: add/ssh-flags-without-secrets
note: Save flags on with nothing typed: the flags are stored, nothing is set.

name: add/unknown-label-id
note: Today any label id is stored. Core refuses an id that is neither predefined nor the project's (Decision 7).

name: add/missing-project
note: The row's foreign key fails; the TS rolls the connection back. Core refuses with PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.

toasts.message: Failed to save connection to storage

name: add/duplicate-name
note: Today a second connection may share a name (after trimming and case). Core refuses it (Q3).

name: add/keychain-failure
note: The keychain refuses the set: today the row is saved and a toast says so. Core writes secrets first (Decision 8), so nothing is saved.

steps.inject: secret set fails: SECRET_STORE_ERROR: keychain locked

toasts.message: Could not save password to system keychain

name: add/web-vault-cancelled
note: Web: the vault unlock is cancelled before the save, so nothing is stored.

toasts.message: Vault unlock cancelled — connection not saved. Unlock the vault and try again.

name: update/ai-flags-left-out
note: The input has no AI flags. `update` copies them as given, so today they are cleared; a Core patch that leaves them out keeps them (Decision 2).

name: update/shared-connection
note: A connection that isn't local-only rewrites its shared YAML.

name: labels/set-with-unknown-id
note: `setConnectionLabels` drops an unknown id silently today. Core refuses the patch (Decision 7).

name: labels/other-projects-label
note: A label of another project is refused by both: the TS drops it (not among the connection's project's labels), Core refuses it.

name: reconnect/form-with-new-password
note: A reconnect from the connection tab saves what was connected and `lastConnected`.

name: reconnect/saved
note: `autoReconnect` connects the saved row and saves it again with `lastConnected`; the save flags and secrets are left alone.

name: remove/unknown-id
note: Today removing an id that isn't stored succeeds and deletes its (absent) secrets. Core answers SAVED_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND.

name: update/secret-kept-when-absent
note: The password is saved (flag on, db:c1 stored) and the form sends no password: another field changes and the stored secret stays.

name: update/rename-to-own-name-other-case
note: Renaming a connection to its own name in another case isn't a clash with itself.

name: update/existing-duplicates-stay
note: Two stored rows already share a name (Q3: they stay). Patching another field of one of them succeeds.

name: add/duplicate-name-full-case-folding
note: Names compare after NFC and full Unicode case folding: "STRASSE" is "Straße". Today allowed; Core refuses.

name: add-then-update-then-remove
note: Ids: the created row is the one the later calls name.
